full_page.content:
1932, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 48 Cont.
June 29 Mr. V. Mem Park. Evelyn Zielinski - 5 - Eyes weak.
Blank Page
1932, July
Page 49 Page 50 July Mrs. Josephine Gumbino - 30 - Can hardly see to read at all - head - aches etc.
J. L. Mcclellan - 34 - non Catholic, drinking - neglecting family. ...
A. Haener - 46 - starving herself sick to "reduce" ....
Rayborn Skonk - 12 - Epil .. . ? ?? Sister M. Cajeran - goiter ....
July 9
Little Catherine Austin died - went to Heaven we trust, one year in bed.
Edmond Vier - trying to sell property to save other property to sup- port family of 9
John Briarley - 12 - Serious kidney trouble - 3 - days in hospital for examination $93 ...... Wants to be a priest.
Theodore G. - Gall-stones
Blank Page
Page 51 Page 52 July 9 Jean Dorothy Grumiaux - non Cath. - 5 - injured at birth, can not talk except a few words - only child 16 yrs. married.
Marie D. of Flint - 14 - paralysed since 2 - understands but cannot speak.
Mary Ventimglia - 14 - lost hearing 3 years ago.
Mrs. Cunningham - 9423 Henley Pl.
Mrs. Anna Flynn - 81 - of Buffalo, N. Y. - double cataracts, her sister Miss Connors asks for prayers.
